CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant`
AS select date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       a.currentstatus as deliverystatus,
       b.status as oms_status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType,
       count(distinct deliveryid) as NumberOfDeliveries,
       sum(b.quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b 
where date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -35 DAY )
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and a.customdata not like '%"IsPhysicalDelivery":"false"%'
      and b.definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları')
      and b.initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode
group by date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey'),
       a.currentstatus,
       b.status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType;
;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.MP_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       merchant_name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= false;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant_v2`
AS select date(orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       status as oms_status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end as platform_oms,
       sum(quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from  `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline`  
where date(orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and status not in ('Cancelled')
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and lineitemtype not in ('Donation','BnplHandlingFee')
      and name not in ('Hepsiburada Premium','Hepsiburada Aylık Premium')
group by date(orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.cargo_change_instant`
AS select dy as ChangeDate,
       properties.cargoCompany.name as NewCargo,
       cast(properties.previousCargoCompanyId as string) as Oldcargo,
       properties.MerchantName as Merchant_Name,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode!='' then messageid end) as ChangeAfterPacked,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode='' then messageid end) as ChangeBeforePacked,
       count(distinct messageid) as TotalChange      
from `hb-davinci-prod.davinci.MerchantCargoChange`
where dy>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -10 DAY )
      and properties.status='Success'
      and properties.previousCargoCompanyId in (21,28) 
group by dy,
       properties.cargoCompany.name,
       properties.previousCargoCompanyId,
       properties.MerchantName;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.depo_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= true;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant`
AS select date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       a.currentstatus as deliverystatus,
       b.status as oms_status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType,
       count(distinct deliveryid) as NumberOfDeliveries,
       sum(b.quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b 
where date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -35 DAY )
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and a.customdata not like '%"IsPhysicalDelivery":"false"%'
      and b.definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları')
      and b.initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode
group by date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey'),
       a.currentstatus,
       b.status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType;
;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.MP_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       merchant_name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= false;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant_v2`
AS select date(orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       status as oms_status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end as platform_oms,
       sum(quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from  `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline`  
where date(orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and status not in ('Cancelled')
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and lineitemtype not in ('Donation','BnplHandlingFee')
      and name not in ('Hepsiburada Premium','Hepsiburada Aylık Premium')
group by date(orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.cargo_change_instant`
AS select dy as ChangeDate,
       properties.cargoCompany.name as NewCargo,
       cast(properties.previousCargoCompanyId as string) as Oldcargo,
       properties.MerchantName as Merchant_Name,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode!='' then messageid end) as ChangeAfterPacked,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode='' then messageid end) as ChangeBeforePacked,
       count(distinct messageid) as TotalChange      
from `hb-davinci-prod.davinci.MerchantCargoChange`
where dy>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -10 DAY )
      and properties.status='Success'
      and properties.previousCargoCompanyId in (21,28) 
group by dy,
       properties.cargoCompany.name,
       properties.previousCargoCompanyId,
       properties.MerchantName;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.depo_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= true;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant`
AS select date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       a.currentstatus as deliverystatus,
       b.status as oms_status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType,
       count(distinct deliveryid) as NumberOfDeliveries,
       sum(b.quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b 
where date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -35 DAY )
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and a.customdata not like '%"IsPhysicalDelivery":"false"%'
      and b.definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları')
      and b.initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode
group by date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey'),
       a.currentstatus,
       b.status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType;
;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.MP_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       merchant_name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= false;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant_v2`
AS select date(orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       status as oms_status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end as platform_oms,
       sum(quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from  `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline`  
where date(orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and status not in ('Cancelled')
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and lineitemtype not in ('Donation','BnplHandlingFee')
      and name not in ('Hepsiburada Premium','Hepsiburada Aylık Premium')
group by date(orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.cargo_change_instant`
AS select dy as ChangeDate,
       properties.cargoCompany.name as NewCargo,
       cast(properties.previousCargoCompanyId as string) as Oldcargo,
       properties.MerchantName as Merchant_Name,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode!='' then messageid end) as ChangeAfterPacked,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode='' then messageid end) as ChangeBeforePacked,
       count(distinct messageid) as TotalChange      
from `hb-davinci-prod.davinci.MerchantCargoChange`
where dy>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -10 DAY )
      and properties.status='Success'
      and properties.previousCargoCompanyId in (21,28) 
group by dy,
       properties.cargoCompany.name,
       properties.previousCargoCompanyId,
       properties.MerchantName;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.depo_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= true;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant`
AS select date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       a.currentstatus as deliverystatus,
       b.status as oms_status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType,
       count(distinct deliveryid) as NumberOfDeliveries,
       sum(b.quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b 
where date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -35 DAY )
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and a.customdata not like '%"IsPhysicalDelivery":"false"%'
      and b.definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları')
      and b.initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode
group by date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey'),
       a.currentstatus,
       b.status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType;
;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.MP_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       merchant_name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= false;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant_v2`
AS select date(orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       status as oms_status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end as platform_oms,
       sum(quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from  `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline`  
where date(orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and status not in ('Cancelled')
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and lineitemtype not in ('Donation','BnplHandlingFee')
      and name not in ('Hepsiburada Premium','Hepsiburada Aylık Premium')
group by date(orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.cargo_change_instant`
AS select dy as ChangeDate,
       properties.cargoCompany.name as NewCargo,
       cast(properties.previousCargoCompanyId as string) as Oldcargo,
       properties.MerchantName as Merchant_Name,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode!='' then messageid end) as ChangeAfterPacked,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode='' then messageid end) as ChangeBeforePacked,
       count(distinct messageid) as TotalChange      
from `hb-davinci-prod.davinci.MerchantCargoChange`
where dy>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -10 DAY )
      and properties.status='Success'
      and properties.previousCargoCompanyId in (21,28) 
group by dy,
       properties.cargoCompany.name,
       properties.previousCargoCompanyId,
       properties.MerchantName;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.depo_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= true;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant`
AS select date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       a.currentstatus as deliverystatus,
       b.status as oms_status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType,
       count(distinct deliveryid) as NumberOfDeliveries,
       sum(b.quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b 
where date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -35 DAY )
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and a.customdata not like '%"IsPhysicalDelivery":"false"%'
      and b.definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları')
      and b.initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode
group by date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey'),
       a.currentstatus,
       b.status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType;
;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.MP_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       merchant_name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= false;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant_v2`
AS select date(orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       status as oms_status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end as platform_oms,
       sum(quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from  `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline`  
where date(orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and status not in ('Cancelled')
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and lineitemtype not in ('Donation','BnplHandlingFee')
      and name not in ('Hepsiburada Premium','Hepsiburada Aylık Premium')
group by date(orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.cargo_change_instant`
AS select dy as ChangeDate,
       properties.cargoCompany.name as NewCargo,
       cast(properties.previousCargoCompanyId as string) as Oldcargo,
       properties.MerchantName as Merchant_Name,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode!='' then messageid end) as ChangeAfterPacked,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode='' then messageid end) as ChangeBeforePacked,
       count(distinct messageid) as TotalChange      
from `hb-davinci-prod.davinci.MerchantCargoChange`
where dy>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -10 DAY )
      and properties.status='Success'
      and properties.previousCargoCompanyId in (21,28) 
group by dy,
       properties.cargoCompany.name,
       properties.previousCargoCompanyId,
       properties.MerchantName;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.depo_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= true;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant`
AS select date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       a.currentstatus as deliverystatus,
       b.status as oms_status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType,
       count(distinct deliveryid) as NumberOfDeliveries,
       sum(b.quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b 
where date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -35 DAY )
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and a.customdata not like '%"IsPhysicalDelivery":"false"%'
      and b.definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları')
      and b.initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode
group by date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey'),
       a.currentstatus,
       b.status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType;
;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.MP_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       merchant_name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= false;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant_v2`
AS select date(orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       status as oms_status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end as platform_oms,
       sum(quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from  `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline`  
where date(orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and status not in ('Cancelled')
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and lineitemtype not in ('Donation','BnplHandlingFee')
      and name not in ('Hepsiburada Premium','Hepsiburada Aylık Premium')
group by date(orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.cargo_change_instant`
AS select dy as ChangeDate,
       properties.cargoCompany.name as NewCargo,
       cast(properties.previousCargoCompanyId as string) as Oldcargo,
       properties.MerchantName as Merchant_Name,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode!='' then messageid end) as ChangeAfterPacked,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode='' then messageid end) as ChangeBeforePacked,
       count(distinct messageid) as TotalChange      
from `hb-davinci-prod.davinci.MerchantCargoChange`
where dy>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -10 DAY )
      and properties.status='Success'
      and properties.previousCargoCompanyId in (21,28) 
group by dy,
       properties.cargoCompany.name,
       properties.previousCargoCompanyId,
       properties.MerchantName;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.depo_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= true;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant`
AS select date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       a.currentstatus as deliverystatus,
       b.status as oms_status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType,
       count(distinct deliveryid) as NumberOfDeliveries,
       sum(b.quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b 
where date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -35 DAY )
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and a.customdata not like '%"IsPhysicalDelivery":"false"%'
      and b.definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları')
      and b.initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode
group by date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey'),
       a.currentstatus,
       b.status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType;
;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.MP_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       merchant_name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= false;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant_v2`
AS select date(orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       status as oms_status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end as platform_oms,
       sum(quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from  `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline`  
where date(orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and status not in ('Cancelled')
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and lineitemtype not in ('Donation','BnplHandlingFee')
      and name not in ('Hepsiburada Premium','Hepsiburada Aylık Premium')
group by date(orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       status,
       merchant_name,
       merchant_isRetail,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       case when merchant_isRetail =true then 'RT'
            when merchant_isRetail =false and warehouse_shippingAddressLabel like '%HepsiLojistik%' then 'FF' else 'MP' end;;

       cast(properties.previousCargoCompanyId as string) as Oldcargo,
       properties.MerchantName as Merchant_Name,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode!='' then messageid end) as ChangeAfterPacked,
       count(distinct case when properties.DeliveryCode='' then messageid end) as ChangeBeforePacked,
       count(distinct messageid) as TotalChange      
from `hb-davinci-prod.davinci.MerchantCargoChange`
where dy>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -10 DAY )
      and properties.status='Success'
      and properties.previousCargoCompanyId in (21,28) 
group by dy,
       properties.cargoCompany.name,
       properties.previousCargoCompanyId,
       properties.MerchantName;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.depo_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= true;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant`
AS select date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       a.currentstatus as deliverystatus,
       b.status as oms_status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType,
       count(distinct deliveryid) as NumberOfDeliveries,
       sum(b.quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b 
where date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -35 DAY )
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and a.customdata not like '%"IsPhysicalDelivery":"false"%'
      and b.definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları')
      and b.initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode
group by date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey'),
       a.currentstatus,
       b.status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType;
;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.MP_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       merchant_name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= false;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.depo_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= true;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant`
AS select date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       a.currentstatus as deliverystatus,
       b.status as oms_status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType,
       count(distinct deliveryid) as NumberOfDeliveries,
       sum(b.quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b 
where date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -35 DAY )
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and a.customdata not like '%"IsPhysicalDelivery":"false"%'
      and b.definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları')
      and b.initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode
group by date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey'),
       a.currentstatus,
       b.status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType;
;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.MP_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       merchant_name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= false;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.depo_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= true;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant`
AS select date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       a.currentstatus as deliverystatus,
       b.status as oms_status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType,
       count(distinct deliveryid) as NumberOfDeliveries,
       sum(b.quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b 
where date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -35 DAY )
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and a.customdata not like '%"IsPhysicalDelivery":"false"%'
      and b.definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları')
      and b.initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode
group by date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey'),
       a.currentstatus,
       b.status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType;
;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.MP_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       merchant_name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= false;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.depo_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= true;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.adetler_instant`
AS select date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey') as order_date,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       a.currentstatus as deliverystatus,
       b.status as oms_status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType,
       count(distinct deliveryid) as NumberOfDeliveries,
       sum(b.quantity) as TotalProductQuantity
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b 
where date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -32 DAY )
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -35 DAY )
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and a.customdata not like '%"IsPhysicalDelivery":"false"%'
      and b.definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları')
      and b.initialdelivery_optionid != '99'
      and a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode
group by date(b.orderdatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey'),
       date(a.detail_Acceptdate,'Turkey'),
       a.currentstatus,
       b.status,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       a.platform,
       a.deliveryType;
;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.MP_backlog`
AS select date(orderDateTime,'Turkey') as orderdate,
       extract (week from (CURRENT_DATE())) as current_week,
       warehouseId,
       ordernumber,
       sku,
       quantity,
       warehouse_shippingAddressLabel,
       name,
       merchant_name,
       date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey') as ESD,
       case when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')>current_Date('Turkey') then 'Forward_ESD'
            when date(estimatedshippingdate,'Turkey')=current_Date('Turkey') then 'Current_Day_ESD'
            else 'Backward_ESD' end as ESD_Time
from `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` 
where date(orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -30 day)
      and status='Placed'
      and tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and definitionname not in ('Çekiliş','Hediye Kartları','Hizmet Bedeli')
      and initialDelivery_optionId != '99'
      and merchant_isRetail= false;;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;

CREATE VIEW `hb-dagitim-gelistirme.kpi.created_time_distribution_instant`
AS select distinct a.deliveryid,
       b.merchant_name,
       a.cargocompany,
       b.merchant_sapid,
       a.sender_city,
       a.sender_town,
       a.sender_district,
       date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey') as created_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey'))) as created_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.deliverydatetime, 'Turkey')) as created_hour_all,
       date(a.detail_acceptdate,'Turkey') as accept_date,
       extract (hour from (datetime(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey'))) as accept_hour,
       format_time("%R",time(a.detail_acceptdate, 'Turkey')) as accept_hour_all
from `hb-delivery-prod.delivery_flat.delivery` a, `hb-oms-shared-prod.oms_flat.orderline` b
where a.deliveryid=b.deliverycode 
      and a.deliverydirection='MERCHANT_TO_CUSTOMER'
      and b.tenant='Hepsiburada'
      and date(b.orderDateTime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -40 day)
      and date(a.deliverydatetime,'Turkey')>=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(),interval -32 day);;
